_meta.description: More Map Variations chr imports â€” cross-game boss ports. REQUIRES the MMV mod (https://www.nexusmods.com/eldenringnightreign/mods/578) installed in your me3 profile. Without MMV's regulation + chr assets, enabling this will cause CTDs because the rando will reference chrs that don't exist in your active regulation.
_meta.enable_instructions: If you have MMV installed: set _meta.enabled=true and run normally. The 13 c-prefixes in blacklist_when_active are blocked because they CTD or have missing assets even WITH MMV â€” leave them. If you don't have MMV: leave _meta.enabled=false. The rando will run on vanilla NR + DLC content only.
_meta.requires: MMV mod installed in me3 profile

blacklist_when_active._note: When mmv_imports._meta.enabled=true, ALL c-prefixes in all three lists are added to V3_EXCLUDE_TARGET_PREFIXES at load_data time. Disabling MMV (set _meta.enabled=false) removes the blacklist â€” appropriate when running vanilla NR regulation where DLC chrs are functional and MMV chrs don't exist. v0.23.39: c8500 Manus added (DS1, asset graph too divergent). v0.23.46: c8300 Dragonslayer Armor was initially added â€” CTD with access violation (memory write to NULL+0x24) reported. LATER VINDICATED in subsequent playtest: works fine when properly slotted, original CTD attribution was incorrect. Removed from blacklist. v0.23.55: c4720 Godfrey was initially added â€” CTD on Castle approach (seed 961158) reported. LATER VINDICATED in subsequent playtest: works fine. Removed from blacklist. v0.23.72: new ai_broken category added for MMV imports whose AI behaves unreliably even though chrbnd/anibnd load cleanly (no CTD, no asset miss â€” just busted combat behavior). c5840 Black Knight added (DS3 port, MMV import) â€” AI unreliable in field placements. Parallels V3_HERITAGE_AI_KNOWN_ISSUES on the heritage side but uses full exclusion rather than SENSITIVE-only restriction. v0.23.72-late: user playtest sweep of MMV chrs near m60_43_37_20 encampment (Sentient Pest seed 35300). c5840 Black Knight escalated from ai_broken â†’ ctd_unidentified after confirmed CTD encountered in field. c5880 Catacombs Sorcerer (DS3 import) added to ctd_unidentified â€” CTD on encounter. c6201 Scarab (ER import) added to ctd_unidentified â€” CTD on encounter; suspect because c6201 is also the summoned Scarab attached to c6200 Gael's fight (variants 62001000-62005200 are c6200 Gael-summon Scarabs but c6201 is a separate MMV import), so c6201 may have asset linkage issues independent of Gael. c2030 Rennala added to ai_broken â€” loads + fights but renders with a floating-in-air pose anomaly (visual glitch, not CTD). v0.23.72-tunnel: c1260 Hollow Manserving Servant (Bloodborne, the only BB-origin chr in the MMV manifest) added to ctd_unidentified after user CTD entering tunnel m34_10 where c1260 was placed at pi=10. Same cross-game-engine asset divergence class as c8500 Manus (DS1) â€” BB chrbnd/anibnd format does not link cleanly into NR's loader. Banning c1260 removes all BB content from the rando, which is consistent with the cross-engine compatibility pattern observed across DS1/BB imports. v0.24.46: c8500 Manus un-banned per Alaric playtest direction. Pattern matches the c8300 Dragonslayer Armor (v0.23.46) and c4720 Godfrey (v0.23.55) vindication trajectory — original v0.23.39 attribution to 'DS1 asset graph divergence' may have been the same class of position-specific anim-slot mismatch now caught by V3_FLYING_REQUIRED_SLOTS / V3_QUADRUPED_UNSAFE_SLOTS added in subsequent releases. blacklist_when_active._note_phase_transition_broken: c8300 Dragonslayer Armor (DS3 import). HP-threshold phase transition (ground-slam weapon plant that grants phase-2 marker 11300) plays to completion, boss rises, then FREEZES idle and never resumes combat when RELOCATED. NOT a CTD, NOT missing assets, NOT the battle AI. Characterized 2026-05 over an extended diagnosis; distinguishing it from the speculative-CTD bans in _note (c8300 was itself vindicated once in v0.23.46 — this ban is different: it is a reproducible, characterized transition failure, not a one-off crash attribution). Eliminations, all by playtest: (1) removed all modified EMEVD -> still froze (not the nb_phase_reenable layer); (2) AI leap-swap 3200-3203->phase-1 anims, witchy-confirmed loaded -> still froze (not AI move selection); (3) CSV forcing 11300 via param conditionHpRate -> still froze (not marker source); (4) placeholder anibnd supplying the 8 TAE-referenced-but-absent anims incl 20013/3200-3203 -> still froze (not missing animations — and the transition anim demonstrably PLAYS); (5) forced phase-1-only (all HasSpecialEffectId(11300) reads -> false, Act07 unreachable), witchy-confirmed -> still froze (the transition trigger is OUTSIDE the battle AI); (6) single-attack sanity build -> DID restrict to one attack, proving the luabnd loads and edits take effect, AND the ground-slam + freeze still occurred -> the transition fires from outside the editable AI/behavior layers. Root: the phase transition is triggered at an HP threshold by a mechanism not in the battle AI, not in a conditionHpRate speffect, and not in the shared c9997 behavior graph (which has no HP/phase variables); the post-transition combat resume fails in the relocated context. c8300's own behbnd is a thin wrapper delegating to c9997, so the transition's exit-to-combat is not editable with the surgical tooling here — it would need Havok behavior-graph re-authoring. Banning rather than fixing. To revisit: would need (a) a home-arena (m49_53) control fight to confirm whether it freezes at home too (broken import) vs only relocated (relocation dependency) — never obtained, user has not fought home c8300; and (b) genuine behavior-graph authoring. If the 'two distinct characters' import model is adopted, c8300-as-phase-1-only could re-enter via that path (phase-1 AI works fine; it's the transition that's broken). Do NOT lift on the c8300/c4720/c5840 vindication-pattern reasoning — those were CTD mis-attributions; this is a characterized freeze. v0.27.48 (Alaric): c8500 Manus added — playtest confirms same characterized-freeze pattern: HP threshold → specific attack animation → AI freeze, no combat resume. Same class as c8300 (transition trigger outside editable battle AI / behavior layers). This overturns the v0.24.46 un-ban (which un-banned c8500 on the c8300/c4720/c5840 vindication-pattern reasoning) — and the warning above ('Do NOT lift on the c8300/c4720/c5840 vindication-pattern reasoning — those were CTD mis-attributions; this is a characterized freeze') applies to that v0.24.46 lift in reverse: it WAS the vindication-pattern reasoning applied prophylactically before any characterized failure was observed. Now characterized, re-banned. Also overturns the prior 'single_phase' classification in data/phase_transition_imports.json _excluded — c8500 was assumed transition-free; the playtest establishes it has one. Same to-revisit options as c8300 (Havok behavior-graph re-authoring, or phase-1-only 'two distinct characters' import). v0.31 (Alaric, Tricephalos/Gladius N1 playtest): c5130 Messmer the Impaler (Phase 1) added — but this is a TEMPORARY ban of a DIFFERENT, FIXABLE class than c8300/c8500. c5130 is NOT an outside-the-AI transition freeze: it is in data/phase_transition_imports.json with a verified marker (20010612) and its AI re-enable works — it froze at the m49_24 night-boss arena (entity 49240800) because nb_phase_reenable's v0.27.40 encounter-init scan does not register the re-enable at that scripted NB arena (a coverage regression from dropping the _NB_BOSS_ENTITY_IDS catalog). Fix is the scan∪catalog union registration tracked in dev/TODO_c5130_messmer_reenable.md; UN-BAN c5130 once that lands. Phase 2 (c5140) is a standalone post-transition entity, has no transition trigger, and is NOT affected — it stays in the pool. Do NOT migrate c5130 to the permanent/Havok-reauthoring bucket; it is purely an EMEVD registration-coverage gap.
